name: Defender
description: A plain-hilted longsword whose flat is engraved with a closed gate.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this enchantment; this one is a longsword. It strikes far truer and harder than a plain sword. The first time you attack with it on your turn, you can move any part of that bonus off the blade and onto your Armor Class, until the start of your next turn, as long as you keep hold of it.

features.name: Guard
features.text: The first time you attack with it on your turn, move up to 3 of its attack and damage bonus to your Armor Class until the start of your next turn.
